title: VoxelCore preload.json
description: Assets to preload (<pack>/preload.json), read by AssetsLoader::processPreloadConfig. Only list assets that aren't loaded automatically (layouts, block/item textures and models of content units load by themselves).
markdownDescription: Assets to preload (`<pack>/preload.json`), read by `AssetsLoader::processPreloadConfig`. Only list assets that aren't loaded automatically (layouts, block/item textures and models of content units load by themselves).

name.description: Asset name (also the default path inside the category folder).

path.description: File path relative to the pack (default: textures/<name>).

animation.markdownDescription: Texture animations. Entries are names relative to `textures/` (no extension) or objects with options.
animation.description: Texture animations. Entries are names relative to textures/ (no extension) or objects with options.

type.description: atlas: pack the folder into one atlas; separate: keep the textures separate.

atlases.description: Texture atlases built from a folder of textures/. Entries are names relative to textures/ (no extension) or objects with options.

name.description: Asset name (also the default path inside the category folder).
